points.description: States that a stack is a data structure (or abstract data type / collection).
States that it stores/holds a collection of elements (items).
States that the last item added is the first to be removed (LIFO behaviour); equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: 1.5 marks if LIFO is named only as an acronym or the ordering is stated vaguely or partly (e.g. 'items are added and removed from the top' without stating the last-in is first-out).
